name: ANSI/IEEE Measuring relay form
summary: IEEE-library form of measuring relay: a measuring relay responds to a measured electrical quantity and issues an output according to its configuration.
description: This reference locates measuring relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented relays and contacts family. A measuring relay responds to a measured electrical quantity and issues an output according to its configuration. Measurement inputs, auxiliary supply and output contacts may be separate terminal groups. The public library uses HCR1MSR for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Identify the measured quantity before tracing the output contact logic. A measuring relay is not simply a coil powered by the same quantity it measures. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
